title: 7.02 / Approval Process
slide_intent: Supply context alongside artwork so a reviewer can judge the intended application.
strategic_value: A shared approval route can keep Spectrum’s logo and copy consistent across mall-produced assets.
demonstration: A cyan approval requirement sits left of a contact paragraph and submission checklist; a top note gives review timing.
practical_value: Assemble artwork, copy and placement details before requesting review, without assuming the archival contact remains current.

content_islands.name: Heading and timing
content_islands.spec: Place the title upper left and the five-business-day review note at upper middle.

content_islands.name: Approval requirement
content_islands.spec: Set the all-uses requirement in cyan at the left of the ruled content area.

content_islands.name: Submission checklist
content_islands.spec: Place contact guidance and bullets at right covering subject, asset description, placement, contact details and separate design and copy files.
